instruction: Turn on a virtual keyboard that allows me to input text by clicking with my mouse.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: ON_SCREEN_KB=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-keyboard-enabled 2>/dev/null); if [ "$ON_SCREEN_KB" = "true" ]; then echo "On-screen keyboard enabled"; else echo "On-screen keyboard not enabled"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the on-screen keyboard for accessibility. The evaluator checks if org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-keyboard-enabled is set to true via gsettings.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings command checks screen-keyboard-enabled boolean value in org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications schema
